# SEC Filing Fee Calculator

> Free local-first, no-tracking SEC filing fee calculator using the FY2026 $138.10 per $1,000,000 filing fee rate for 10/1/2025 to 9/30/2026.

Site: https://sec-filing-fee-calculator.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Turner-Levey/sec-filing-fee-calculator
Preview image: https://sec-filing-fee-calculator.vercel.app/preview.png
Tiny Tool Town listing: https://www.tinytooltown.com/tools/sec-filing-fee-calculator/
Awesome SEC Filings listing: https://github.com/vibeyclaw/awesome-sec-filings#general-sec-filings
No-Login Tools listing: https://nologin.tools/tool/sec-filing-fee-calculator-vercel-app/

## Tool

- [SEC Filing Fee Calculator](https://sec-filing-fee-calculator.vercel.app/): Estimate SEC filing fees from aggregate amount or shares times price, subtract a prior fee offset, copy a memo, or download an EX-FILING-FEES review row.

## Related Standalone SEC Tools

- [Schedule 13D / 13G Deadline Calculator](https://sec-13d-13g-deadline-calculator.vercel.app/): Estimate common beneficial ownership reporting target dates, copy a source-linked memo, or export a CSV planning row.
- [Form D Deadline Calculator](https://form-d-deadline-calculator.vercel.app/): Estimate a Form D notice target date from a Regulation D first-sale date, copy a source-linked memo, or export a CSV planning row.
- [Section 16 Deadline Calculator](https://section-16-deadline-calculator.vercel.app/): Estimate common SEC Form 3, Form 4, and Form 5 insider reporting target dates, copy a source-linked memo, or export a CSV planning row.

## Notes

- Runs entirely in the browser.
- No signup, cookies, analytics, beacons, uploads, external scripts, or browser storage.
- Includes common amount examples, rate-period wording, and FAQ structured data for rate, EDGAR/FEPT validation, and Section 31 transaction-fee boundaries.
- Informational worksheet only; not legal advice, accounting advice, payment instruction, SEC affiliation, EDGAR validation, or an EDGAR filing service.
